name: Divider Dave
description:
About This Game

Why be alone when you can be by yourself?



Dave wakes up in a pod with one skill and no idea why: he can copy himself. Between him and the exit: lasers, crushing blocks, and doors that have no business being locked.

A slapstick puzzle-platformer where every copy of Dave is a tool, a platform, and a potential sacrifice. He doesn't mind. Probably.

What you'll do:

  • Clone yourself and swap between copies
  • Launch, stack and squash your doubles to reach places one Dave never could
  • Zap clones into crates with the Davebox beam and shove them around
  • Dodge lasers, sneak past detection zones, ride tractor beams, and teleport through portals
  • Solve 50+ handcrafted puzzles across 4 zones: the Lab, the Vents, the Warehouse and the Office


Every Dave is expendable. Can you take OG Dave all the way to the end?

Something is wrong in this facility:

A shadow keeps watching you from the vents. Mysterious box-men that look strangely familiar. A man in a suit, laughing in an office you haven't reached yet. Answers at the top floor.

Also in the box:

  • Expressive pixel art, hand-made and animated, with slapstick cartoon energy: every squash, zap and untimely end is animated with love
  • Original soundtrack by Leo "Tolgy" Cakmak
  • Fully localized in 19 languages
  • One evening of quality time with yourself. And yourself. And yourself.
short_desc: A slapstick puzzle-platformer where cloning yourself is the solution to everything. Launch your doubles, stack them, turn them into boxes. Dave doesn't mind. Probably.
